opt_in_contract.default: None everywhere; every pre-existing caller (RA-05/06/07, FUP-02) is unchanged

opt_in_contract.verification: FP01-T02 on the real engine path (tests/fp_corrective/test_fp01_engine_path.py): forced rejection of every fold yields NO_ADMITTED_DEPLOYMENT with empty equity/fills; forced admission deploys exactly the raw stock record
